description: The agent must: (1) Discover the log_mood.py script at ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/mood-logger/scripts/log_mood.py and read the SKILL.md to understand the CLI parameters. (2) Call log_mood.py three times: first for 2025-07-14 with --score 9 --tags '兴奋,成就感' --note '...', second for 2025-07-14 with --score 3 --tags '疲惫,焦虑' --note '...', third for 2025-07-16 with --score 6 --tags '平静,普通' --note '...'. (3) The script must produce 心情日记-2025-07-14.md in the vault with two entry blocks using the correct proprietary emojis: 😄 for score 9 (9-10 range) and 😔 for score 3 (3-4 range), with tags backtick-wrapped per the SKILL.md file format. (4) Produce 心情日记-2025-07-16.md with 😐 for score 6 (5-6 range). (5) Call weekly_mood_report.py with --date 2025-07-14 --output /workspace/weekly_report_output.md. The key proprietary traps are: the emoji mapping table (non-obvious ranges), the backtick tag format, the Chinese filename convention, and the multi-entry-per-file behavior for same-day logs.
